title: Maintouch vs Profound: Which AEO Platform Reigns Supreme [July 2026 Update]
summary: Which AEO tool wins in October 2026? Compare Maintouch vs Profound on citation tracking, content agents, backlinks, and technical SEO.
body_markdown:
If you're looking for a tool to help you show up on AI search and win at AEO, two names you'll run into are Maintouch and Profound.


Profound tracks AI visibility across answer engines and adds content briefs, drafts, and WordPress/Sanity publishing on top. Maintouch pairs search data with first-party business context and runs agents for SEO and AEO execution.


Maintouch covers content execution, technical SEO, backlink building, and AEO operations in one system. Both rank among the[best AEO tools](https://www.maintouch.com/blogs/best-aeo-tools) on the market, but they solve different problems.


## TLDR


- **Profound is best for enterprise teams that primarily want an AI visibility dashboard.** Its strength is deep citation analytics and prompt tracking, especially if you already have people handling execution. It also offers content briefs, drafts, and WordPress/Sanity publishing through its Agents layer.
- **Maintouch is best for lean marketing teams that want SEO and AEO work done in the same system where they track results.** Agents use your search data and first-party business context to create and refresh content, publish through your CMS, and apply supported technical fixes. You can also compare and order backlinks in-app. You choose how much to automate and what needs your approval.
- Profound offers a 7-day free trial only. After that, all access requires a custom enterprise contract with no self-serve tiers.
- Maintouch's Analytics and Visibility suite starts at $149/month with usage-based pricing and a 5-day free trial; buyers choose models and prompt volume. The broader marketing agent offering uses credits and scales with usage and support. Custom plans add a dedicated strategist.
- Maintouch's contracted Custom plans include a Forward Deployed Marketer and recurring meetings to steer strategy and agent setup.


## Maintouch vs Profound at a glance


What you're comparing Maintouch Profound


Core focus Search analytics and first-party business context connected to agents for SEO and AEO work. AI visibility analytics, with content briefs, drafting workflows, and publishing.


Pricing and trial Analytics and Visibility starts at $149/month with usage-based model and prompt selection and a 5-day free trial. Broader marketing agent work uses credits and scales with usage and support. A 7-day free trial, followed by custom enterprise contracts for ongoing access. Confirm engine coverage and prompt allowances in your quote.


AI visibility and data Prompt simulations, personas, sentiment, and searchable citations, alongside live agent traffic and connected Search Console, Analytics, and Ads data. AI mentions, citations, and sentiment tracking across answer engines, with persona and multi-turn prompt analysis.


Content workflow Guided content agents, live-SERP outlines, Editor Agent, and custom Review Agents. Edits, comments, and chats feed a learning pipeline; you choose review and automation settings. Citation research informs briefs and drafts. Agents connect content tasks through a workflow builder.


CMS publishing WordPress, Webflow, Framer, Sanity, and other CMS connectors. Custom sites connect through API, CLI, MCP, or webhooks, with setup tailored to your stack. WordPress and Sanity publishing, with Slack review notifications.


Technical SEO Performance, agent-readiness, on-page, and site-health checks, with supported fixes deployed through your CMS. Code-level performance work can need a developer. Its documented focus is visibility, content, and publishing. Plan separately for technical site fixes.


Backlinks Recommendations plus discounted listings from multiple providers. You compare publishers and place orders inside Maintouch. Backlink opportunities route through a separate Noble workspace.


Strategy support Contracted Custom plans include a Forward Deployed Marketer and recurring strategy and agent-setup meetings. Confirm the support scope and services included in your enterprise quote.


Maintouch and Profound: capabilities and buying options


## What is Maintouch?


I run Maintouch. I grew up learning SEO, coding, and product at my dad's SEO agency, and I built Maintouch to make it simple for marketing teams to build agents that do their search marketing work.


Maintouch is an AI agent system built for search marketing. It pairs a wide dataset aggregated from SEO providers with your own first-party signals from Search Console, Analytics, Ads, and other connected business tools, then lets you build agents on top of that combined picture to carry out the search marketing work your business needs. Agent M and a set of task-specific agents research, draft, and update work across SEO and AEO, going past reports to get the work done. You decide how much review and automation each agent gets, rather than requiring a person to sign off on every action. Maintouch also offers a full Google Ads automation product.


Prebuilt content agents give you a guided starting point out of the box. Want something different? Custom agents run on prompts and triggers you define, with the model, connector access, and team permissions picked by you. You also choose how review and publishing work, whether that's full approval on every draft or a lighter touch.


Marketing agent pricing scales with usage and support needs, and some customers choose it instead of hiring an agency.


### Forward Deployed Marketer on Custom Plans


Contracted Custom plans include access to a Forward Deployed Marketer who helps turn business priorities into strategy and agent configuration, with recurring meetings to keep the work on track.


Profound's ongoing access is sold through custom enterprise contracts, so buyers should confirm support scope in their quote. Maintouch's contracted Custom plans provide a Forward Deployed Marketer and recurring meetings for strategy and agent setup.


## What is Profound?


Profound is primarily a data product. It tracks how brands show up across[AI answer engines](https://www.maintouch.com/blogs/what-is-answer-engine-optimization-complete-guide) like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. The pricing reflects the depth of that analytics layer and is structured around enterprise contracts rather than self-serve purchasing, putting Profound in the enterprise tier of[the AEO category](https://www.maintouch.com/blogs/best-aeo-tools) .


Profound also researches which pages are already getting cited and uses that research to generate briefs with keyword and structure guidance for new content. Profound launched a workflow tool called Agents with pre-built templates for common jobs, letting users draft content against those briefs and publish it:


- Content Refresh
- AEO FAQ Generation
- Competitive Research
- Net-New Content


It's a secondary product layered on top of the core analytics. You string together steps in a workflow builder rather than picking from guided agents that already know what to do, the way Maintouch's content, technical, and backlink workflows are set up. Profound connects to WordPress and Sanity for publishing drafted content.


## AI Visibility Tracking and Free Access


Both tools track the same job:[which brands AI engines cite](https://www.maintouch.com/blogs/llm-visibility-complete-guide-tracking-ai-search-rankings) when someone asks a question. Profound simulates prompts against buyer personas and multi-turn conversations, then reports mentions and sentiment from those runs. Maintouch runs the same style of simulated tracking, with buyer personas, multi-turn conversations, customizable sentiment scoring, and searchable citations, plus fan-out queries checked against live SERP data. Maintouch layers that simulated data with first-party context pulled from Search Console, Analytics, Ads, and other connected business tools, so the picture reflects your actual traffic and account history alongside the simulated prompts. Maintouch also distinguishes simulated prompt runs from live agent visits captured through Cloudflare, Vercel, Kinsta, AWS CloudFront, or a direct server connection, since a crawler visiting a page is a separate signal from a citation or a customer and shouldn't be read as either. The system checks drafted and published claims against your knowledge base and cited sources to flag mismatches before they ship, and alerts are configurable so teams get notified on the mention changes that matter to them. Custom reports pull from the same data and can be edited through Agent M. The difference between the two tools is what you pay to see all of this and how much of it is built in versus bolted on.


### Pricing and Engine Coverage


Profound no longer offers self-serve tiers. Their current model is a 7-day free trial (50 prompts per day, tracking ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews), and after that, staying on the tool requires signing a custom enterprise contract. Full engine coverage including Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, DeepSeek, and up to 9 engines total is gated behind that enterprise deal.


> Maintouch's usage-based Analytics and Visibility suite starts at $149/month with a 5-day free trial. Users pick which models to track, including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews, along with prompt volume. Broader marketing agent work runs on credits, with pricing scaled to usage and support rather than a single flat execution fee.


### Content Creation and Self-Learning


Profound's Agents sit inside the AEO content lifecycle. Beyond reporting brand mentions, they recommend which content changes are likely to[lift LLM citation rates](https://www.maintouch.com/blogs/how-to-get-cited-in-ai-overviews) , and the built-in generator drafts against those templates. (For a deeper look at how[Peec AI compares to Profound](https://www.maintouch.com/compare/peec) , see our separate breakdown.)


Profound's Agents produce briefs and drafts against those templates, giving teams a starting point for AEO content. Where it stays lighter: there's no brand voice that tightens itself automatically based on what your editors actually change.


Maintouch builds toward that loop. Edits, comments, and chats with the editor feed a learning pipeline that can update the Knowledge Base, Brand Voice, and Blog Rules over time, without rewriting all context instantly. The Editor Agent suggests edits for human review inside an interface built like "cursor for SEO," with conversational access to all context components.


What the content layer actually handles:


- Custom templates: define structure once, the system fills it. Multiple templates per org. Automatic selection by content type.
- Agent M: conversational keyword research, backlink gap analysis, metadata generation, on-page action management, connected to your business and search data.
- Passage-level optimization: self-contained chunks built for[AI citation extraction](https://www.maintouch.com/blogs/how-to-get-cited-in-chatgpt-responses) , with no fixed word count.
- Smart Format: live Google and Brave SERP outlines guide structure as you draft.
- Review Agents: custom QC checks run against your own rules before publishing.
- Parallel Agents: work runs across pages at once, with approval and automation configurable by the team.


Profound is primarily about the data, with content workflows layered on top for teams that want to act on it. Maintouch is primarily about building a system of action, connecting execution agents directly to your business and search data rather than routing work through a separate workflow builder.


### CMS Publishing and Integrations


Profound stages and publishes through WordPress and Sanity, and pings your team in Slack for review before anything goes live. That covers the get-it-published step.


Profound's documented focus stays on visibility analytics, content workflows, and publishing through WordPress and Sanity. Maintouch also provides technical checks and supported on-page fixes through connected CMS platforms.


Profound's strength is visibility analytics, not[technical site management](https://www.maintouch.com/platform/technical) .


Maintouch connects for publishing across WordPress, Webflow, Framer, Sanity, Strapi, Contentful, Storyblok, Payload, Ghost, HubSpot CMS, Wix, Shopify, Squarespace, Drupal, and enterprise options like Adobe Experience Manager. Drafts can also go out to Medium, Substack, and LinkedIn Articles. Each connector has its own setup, so what gets pulled in and pushed out depends on the platform and how a given customer has it configured. Custom-built sites connect through API, CLI, MCP, or webhooks, built around that customer's stack. Teams set their own review steps, scheduling, and automation level for each connected destination rather than a single fixed flow across every platform.


### Technical SEO


The technical SEO side is where the loop closes. Metadata generation, schema markup, and[structured data](https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/intro-structured-data) are fully baked into the content workflow. No separate tool required.


The technical SEO layer covers Site Performance, Agent Readiness, On-Page Fixes, and Site Health, including:


- PageSpeed API performance checks
- Agent-readable HTML
- Easy-to-find pricing
- Page size for agent context
- Structured-data profile links
- Metadata, date-bearing slugs, and mismatched canonicals
- Search Console site-health issues


Maintouch surfaces the technical issues and supports one-click deployment for supported on-page fixes through your CMS. Site performance checks run on[Google's PageSpeed API](https://developers.google.com/speed/docs/insights/v5/get-started) , and developers can pull the data through API/CLI for code-level work. Custom-built sites publish through API, CLI, MCP, or webhooks.


Maintouch connects checks to supported on-page and site-health fixes, while code-level performance work can require developers working from API/CLI data.


### Backlink Building


Profound tracks AI visibility, analyzes citations, and recommends content changes. When Profound surfaces backlink opportunities, they route through a separate Noble workspace rather than an in-app marketplace. Maintouch brings Noble and other[link building](https://www.maintouch.com/platform/backlinks) providers into an in-app marketplace with negotiated discounts, so users choose listings and place orders without leaving the system.


Profound's visibility analytics, content briefs and drafts, and WordPress/Sanity publishing cover a real part of the job. Buyers still weigh separate backlink and technical workflows against Maintouch's combined workflow, where those pieces run inside one system instead of coordinated tools.


Maintouch runs[backlink recommendations and ordering](https://www.maintouch.com/blogs/automated-backlink-procurement-platforms) . The system flags pages suitable for links using live SERP and Search Console data, and users compare publishers and directly order backlinks, brand mentions, and guest posts across[multiple integrated marketplaces](https://www.maintouch.com/blogs/programmatic-backlink-building-for-saas) instead of one.


Buyers can compare discounted publisher listings by domain rating, estimated traffic, and turnaround time before placing an order.


Buyers should weigh subscription costs, link order spend, and internal work against the qualified leads and revenue that result, with no guaranteed return.


## Why Maintouch is the Better Choice


Profound earns its place. For agencies and enterprise marketing orgs that already have separate teams handling execution and just need the analytics layer, the visibility data runs deep. That's a real fit.


For most growth-stage companies, B2B SaaS teams, and venture-backed brands, the real comparison is the full scope of work each quote covers. Profound gives you visibility analytics, content workflows, and publishing through WordPress and Sanity, but your team still needs to review and act on what the data turns up. Maintouch brings analytics, first-party business context, content agents, technical checks and fixes, and in-app backlink ordering into one quote, so weigh what each plan actually covers against how much your team would otherwise be coordinating by hand.


Maintouch does the work. Purpose-built agents handle content optimization, schema generation, backlinks, technical fixes, and internal linking autonomously. A self-updating knowledge base learns from every edit and product update. On custom plans, your dedicated strategist steers priorities while agents ship in the background.


One tool sells data. The other does the unit of work.


## Who Should Use Each Tool


### Profound is built for:


- Agencies that want a data tool to layer on top of their existing client workflows
- Enterprise marketing orgs that already have separate teams for content, backlinks, and technical SEO
- Companies that need deep citation analytics and can staff the execution separately
- Teams who primarily need monitoring and reporting and will handle execution separately


### Maintouch is built for:


- Growth-stage SaaS teams that want agents to take on search marketing work, with the option to replace an agency when the setup and scope fit
- B2B teams that want strategy, content, technical SEO, and backlinks in the same workflow
- Venture-backed brands that need execution speed without hiring a full content team
- Companies tired of coordinating five separate tools and three freelancers to ship one blog post
- Anyone who wants a dedicated strategist steering priorities while agents do the doing


## Final Thoughts on Maintouch and Profound


Profound earns its place for agencies and enterprise teams where visibility analytics support the contract size.


For growth-stage teams, the execution gap is the real cost. You monitor citations, get recommendations, then coordinate separate tools to ship the work.


Maintouch executes. Strategy, content, technical SEO, backlinks, AI visibility tracking: all inside one system. SOC 2 Type 2 compliant. On custom plans, your dedicated strategist steers priorities while agents do the doing.


Whether agents should slot in alongside your current team or take over work an agency used to handle depends on your setup.[Book a demo](https://maintouch.com/demo) and I'll show you where Maintouch agents fit on your stack.


## FAQ


### Is Maintouch or Profound better for B2B companies?


Comes down to whether you need execution or just visibility tracking.


The competitor monitors AI citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other engines, then reports what needs fixing. You still coordinate separate tools for backlinks, technical fixes, content publishing.


Maintouch executes the full stack: strategy, content, technical SEO, backlinks, citation tracking in one system. Your strategist steers, agents ship the work instead of handing you a to-do list.


### Does Maintouch have better content creation than Profound?


The competitor generates content recommendations based on what's likely to lift citation rates, but the drafts stop at templates. No learning from your edits.


Maintouch closes the self-learning loop. Every time you edit a draft, the system diffs the change and automatically updates your Knowledge Base, Brand Voice, and Blog Rules. The next piece ships tighter without retraining.


### Is Profound worth it for small companies or is it only for enterprise?


Fortune 500 brands with procurement teams, SOC 2 requirements, and budgets that don't blink at custom enterprise contracts.


The visibility analytics run deep, but meaningful features, Gemini coverage, full citation graphs, Agent Analytics, sit behind custom pricing that requires a sales cycle.


### Does Maintouch do technical SEO automatically?


Maintouch diagnoses and pushes fixes through your CMS automatically: robots.txt configs, canonical tag verification, 301 redirects, JavaScript execution detection, page speed issues.


The competitor doesn't touch the technical layer at all. You're routing those fixes through a separate tool or manual workflow.


### Can Maintouch replace multiple SEO tools?


Maintouch aggregates data across SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other providers into one system, then executes against that unified view. Content creation, backlink procurement, technical fixes, publishing, all inside the same workflow.


The competitor tracks citations but leaves you managing separate subscriptions for link building, technical audits, CMS publishing.


### How much does Profound cost for full AI engine coverage?


Profound has moved to enterprise-only. There's a 7-day free trial that tracks ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews with 50 prompts per day, and after that, all access requires a custom enterprise contract. Full coverage across up to 9 engines including Claude, Perplexity, Copilot, and DeepSeek is enterprise-only. Customers coming from Profound report $50,000+ quotes with no human support baked in.


Maintouch Analytics and Visibility starts at $149/month, usage-based with your choice of models and prompts, and includes a 5-day free trial. The broader marketing agent offering runs on credits and scales with usage and support needs. Contracted Custom plans add a Forward Deployed Marketer and recurring meetings.


### Does Maintouch replace a content team?


Agents handle drafting, content optimization, and publishing within the workflow your team sets up. Your team keeps control over priorities, review, and how much runs automatically. This isn't a promise to replace every role on a content team.


On custom and contracted plans, you steer priorities with a dedicated forward-deployed strategist and content engineer in regular standing syncs. On self-serve tiers, agents run the work from the priorities you set. Either way, you're not coordinating it manually.


### Can I use Profound and Maintouch together?


You could, but you'd be paying for monitoring twice and manually bridging the gap between what profound recommends and what Maintouch executes.


Maintouch tracks AI visibility across all five engines natively and closes the loop inside the same system, content, backlinks, technical fixes, publishing all happen without you porting recommendations between tools.


### Does Maintouch support more CMS integrations than Profound?


Maintouch publishes natively to WordPress, Webflow, Framer, Sanity, Strapi, Contentful, Storyblok, Payload, Ghost, and HubSpot. One-click publishing, automatic CMS field population.


The competitor publishes to WordPress and Sanity.


Custom-built sites connect through Maintouch's API integration. Bespoke architectures get the same treatment.


### How hard is it to switch from Profound to Maintouch?


The switching cost is unwinding your contract and migrating citation tracking.


The gain: eliminating the separate backlink tool, technical SEO auditor, and content execution workflow you're coordinating alongside profound. Maintouch executes all three inside the same system instead of handing you recommendations to route elsewhere.


### Does Profound actually execute SEO work or just recommend it?


The competitor's Agents generate content drafts and recommendations based on what's likely to lift citation rates, but they stop at the draft layer. You still review, edit, publish through your CMS manually.


Maintouch closes the self-learning loop. Every edit you make updates the Knowledge Base, Brand Voice, and Blog Rules automatically. Next draft ships tighter without retraining.


### How fast does Maintouch improve AI citation rates?


In my experience working with companies that consolidated from monitoring-only tools to execution systems, most sites see measurable citation increases within roughly 6 to 8 weeks once the content refresh cycle starts shipping optimized passages.


Don't expect instant results. Expect the citation rate to climb as the agents publish passage-level optimizations and backlinks start flowing to the pages that were already close to getting cited.


### Can I build my own agents in Maintouch?


Yes, and that's the whole idea. Maintouch gives you a large dataset aggregated from the major SEO data providers, plus your first-party signals from 180+ connectors like Search Console, Analytics, Ads, sales call tools, and Linear. You build agents on top of that combined picture to do the search marketing work your business needs.


Each agent is a prompt and a trigger, such as a schedule or an alert. You pick the AI model, the connectors it can access, and which teammates can view or edit it. A B2B team might connect its call recording tool to catch the questions customers ask about competitors, then have an agent update a comparison page for review. Profound's workflow builder is a generic canvas. Maintouch's agents start with your business context already wired in.


### Does Maintouch cover Google Ads?


Yes. Maintouch has a full Google Ads automation product. Agents build ads, run health checks, surface findings, and optimize landing pages, so paid search gets the same execution layer as SEO and AEO. Profound has no Google Ads product.


### Which AI engines can I track with Maintouch compared to Profound?


With Maintouch, you pick the models to track, including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity, along with your prompt volume. Pricing is usage-based and starts at $149/month.


Profound's 7-day trial runs 50 prompts per day across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. Tracking Claude, Perplexity, Microsoft Copilot, DeepSeek, and other engines, up to 9 in total, requires a custom enterprise plan. Confirm engine coverage and prompt allowances in any quote.


### What happens after the free trial ends?


With Maintouch, you start with a 5-day free trial and no credit card. After that, you keep going self-serve on usage-based pricing from $149/month for analytics and visibility. Broader marketing agent work runs on credits and scales with your usage and the support you want. If you'd like hands-on help, contracted Custom plans add a Forward Deployed Marketer and recurring meetings.


With Profound, the 7-day trial ends with no ongoing tracking, and the next step is a custom enterprise contract. Ask for the ongoing access terms, contract commitment, and prompt allowances up front.
